lists.title: Empress Elisabeth (Sisi): life behind Netflix's The Empress

events.title: Elisabeth born at the Herzog-Max-Palais
events.text: Elisabeth, later Empress of Austria and known as Sisi, is born in her father's Munich city palace into the Bavarian Wittelsbach family. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: Exact day not given by the cited page. Point marks the palace's approximate former site.

events.title: Betrothal to Franz Joseph at Bad Ischl
events.text: At the imperial summer residence in Bad Ischl, 15-year-old Elisabeth meets Emperor Franz Joseph, and they become engaged. The Netflix series The Empress dramatizes the start of their relationship. The series is fiction; this event is from the cited source.
events.uncertainty: The page gives 1853 for the engagement; the first meeting is described as at Bad Ischl, without separate dates. Point is approximate (imperial villa area).

events.title: Health stay on Corfu
events.text: Elisabeth stays on Corfu for her health and comes to love the island, which later leads to her Achilleion palace. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: Source gives only the year 1860. Point marks Corfu town, approximate.

events.title: Crowned Queen of Hungary in Budapest
events.text: Franz Joseph and Elisabeth are crowned King and Queen of Hungary in Budapest. Gödöllő Palace, a gift from the Hungarian people to the couple, later becomes a favorite retreat. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: Point is approximate, central Budapest (Matthias Church area); the cited page does not name the venue.

events.title: Murdered at Lake Geneva
events.text: Elisabeth is stabbed by the anarchist Luigi Lucheni while walking along the shore of Lake Geneva and dies. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: Point is approximate, the lakeshore near her hotel.

events.title: Buried in the Capuchin Crypt, Vienna
events.text: Her body is brought to Vienna and buried in the Capuchin Crypt. Her wish to be buried on Corfu is not fulfilled. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: The source says burial was seven days after the assassination; the date is computed from 10 September 1898. Point is approximate.

events.title: Achilleion on Corfu sold to Wilhelm II
events.text: Elisabeth's 'dream palace', the Achilleion, was little used after she lost interest in it and is sold to German emperor Wilhelm II. Today it houses a small museum about her. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: The page gives the year only. Point marks the palace's approximate location.

events.title: Birthplace palace demolished
events.text: Her family home in Munich, the Herzog-Max-Palais, is demolished on Hitler's orders and replaced by a bank. Netflix's The Empress (Die Kaiserin, 2022-2026) dramatizes her life; this point comes from the cited historical source, not from any series scene.
events.uncertainty: Source says 1937/38; the earlier year is used. Point is approximate.
